name: craftflow
description: Judgment-driven engineering for Codex: understand the problem, choose a proportionate change, and verify the result.

interface.shortDescription: Make the right change with engineering judgment.
interface.longDescription: Three independently usable skills: plan the right change, build and verify it, or review existing work. Load architecture, code quality, refactoring, React, TanStack Query, and TypeScript references only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Use $craftflow-plan to assess the problem and propose the right scope of change without editing code.
Use $craftflow-build to implement the approved change and verify integration.
Use $craftflow-review to assess this change and its verification evidence without editing files.
